text:
Elise (Sales): Passing Marigold Therapeutics to CS — 300-seat pilot, US-only, wants private VPC deploy with SAML SSO, token-level billing exports, and audit logs. Pilot target go-live week of 2025-11-03. They also plan a one-time large embeddings ingest (~8M vectors) and a nightly ETL that will touch synthetic PII. Please own onboarding and surface infra/compliance blockers.

Jonah (CS): Thanks Elise. Quick q: who is the infra contact and what's the expected concurrency for the ETL vs interactive users? Also any early renewal signals?

Elise (Sales): Contact is Kiran (Marigold infra). ETL: batch ingest over ~36h with peak 6-8k qps; interactive: ~60 concurrent users pilot ramping to ~350 in 3 months. Renewal: they asked about a 12-month commit and a performance SLA on query routes.

Jonah (CS): Noted. Top risks: private deploy lead time (multi-region not needed), HSM/KMS decision for keys, SAML metadata exchange timing, and embedding throughput tuning. Tentative owners: Jonah (onboarding lead), Priya (support/runbook), Marco (eng infra), Elise (sales sponsor). I'll open the ticket and schedule kickoff.

Priya (Support): I'll create a support ticket and stub a runbook with checks: - Validate SAML metadata exchange - VPC peering rules and CIDR overlaps - KMS import vs provider-managed keys - Ingest throttles & shard sizing for 8M vectors - Audit log retention and PII redaction rules - Provision ETA for dedicated GPUs.

handoff-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-8202 "Marigold private deploy + SAML + embeddings" assigned to Priya.

Marco (Eng): Two infra notes: 1) Model family and max seq length will determine GPU footprint and KV/prefix cache sizing. 2) If they want a 70B gen model float16 -> ~8xA100-80GB equiv; with q4_k quant we might do 4xA100. Need model confirmation before provisioning; provisioning lead in this region ~8-12 business days.

Jonah (CS): Action list I'm capturing: 1) Kickoff + enablement (owner: Jonah) 2) Support ticket + runbook (owner: Priya -> SUP-8202) 3) Confirm model & max seq with customer (owner: Elise -> Kiran) 4) Billing export spec + sample (owner: Jonah + Billing Ops) 5) KMS/HSM checklist & compliance note (owner: Marco + Security) 6) Capacity plan for embeddings (owner: Priya + Marco) 7) 1-page SAML checklist for Kiran's infra team (owner: Jonah).

Elise (Sales): I'll ask Kiran today to confirm model family, seq length, and whether the embedding pipeline will use approximate nearest neighbor indexing (vector dims). I'll also surface the renewal interest and capture legal PO timing.

Priya (Support): Runbook snippet in SUP-8202: ```- Validate IdP/SP metadata exchange
- Confirm cert rotation windows and contact
- Verify VPC peering and route propagation
- Run small ingest smoke (10k vectors) before full batch
- Audit logs: decide metadata-only vs full request bodies```

Marco (Eng): I'll post model/quantization recommendations into SUP-8202 by EOD. If they confirm 70B float, expect ~10 business days to provision equivalent dedicated pool; with 4-bit quant we can cut cost/servers by ~45%.

Jonah (CS): Scheduling kickoff: 2025-10-28 09:00 PT (Kiran + Elise + Priya + Marco). Invite sent, please review enablement slides before call (internal link posted in ticket). I'll tag renewal-watch in SFDC and set touchpoints at 180/120/60/30 days.

Elise (Sales): Thanks team. One more ask from Kiran: can we provide a 1-page infra checklist and a short note on billing export sample (CSV layout)? Jonah can you draft and post here before EOD?

Priya (Support): Will do. I'll link SUP-8202 and add runbook ownership. After kickoff we'll convert notes into a persistent onboarding doc and attach the ingestion test plan.

Marco (Eng): I'll add default profiles (cost vs latency) and recommend a conservative KV cache size for 2k seq if they plan long contexts. Also tagging Security for HSM import guidance.

Jonah (CS): Owners confirmed. Closing this thread for the handoff — keep updates in SUP-8202 and the onboarding calendar.
